findings.fix: A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 0 real photograph(s) or clip(s); the rest are interface fragments.
findings.fix: Add two or more real pictures of the customer's world from scripts/assets.mjs, not stock of people at laptops.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 2 sections keep all their content on one side and leave 69% of the width empty: div.mechanism-head.reveal-up (left 995px empty); div.boundary-head.reveal-up (left 995px empty)
findings.fix: Use the whole width the page has set up: put the section's picture, its second column, its list or its figure in the empty half, or set the text larger across the grid. Empty space must be placed, with something on each side of it.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 487px of the width empty: "500 / 500".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
